inputs.<tmp:0>/cache/brigade/refs/shop/<commit::
SCHEMA TASK
	DESC "a change delivered by one pull request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS implemented|implemented
		REQUIRED
	FIELD TYPE feat|fix|test|docs
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MILESTONE @MILESTONE
	FIELD AFTER @TASK
		REPEATABLE
	FIELD DELIVERED_BY uint

SCHEMA MILESTONE
	DESC "the tasks planned for one request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS planned|active|reached
		REQUIRED

SCHEMA RECIPE
	DESC "a kind of work brigade runs as ordered steps; its name is the name of the recipe"
	FIELD SCHEMA_VERSION uint
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MAX_WALL uint
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STEP command
		REQUIRED
		REPEATABLE
		FIELD ARGV string
			REPEATABLE

MILESTONE M1
	TITLE "Empty cart"
	STATUS active

RECIPE acceptance
	SCHEMA_VERSION 1
	MAX_WALL 10
	STEP command
		ARGV "true"

TASK S0
	TITLE "Show the cart"
	STATUS implemented
	TYPE feat

TASK S1
	TITLE "Empty the cart in one click"
	STATUS implemented
	TYPE feat
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
